history.summary: A 1,200 sqft freehold 3BR at Splendour at Still Road (D15, Eunos) at $2.15M / $1,792 PSF, 620m from Eunos MRT. A small/older freehold East-Coast block with no built year and no URA appreciation or txn data to verify the investment case.
history.rating_rationale: $2.15M for a 1,200 sqft freehold 3BR in D15 is a liquid quantum in a deep-buyer-pool district with Eunos EWL MRT 620m away — the location floor is sound. But with no built year, no URA txn count, and no appreciation data, this is a small boutique block whose growth and liquidity are unverifiable; $1,792 PSF is mid-range for D15 freehold so there's no obvious discount to compensate. Ordinary, data-light hold.
